entry.title: BILL060(26) (Honolulu): INTRO → CCL
entry.content:
RELATING TO REAL PROPERTY TAXATION.

Requires the BFS Director to implement and maintain an automated eligibility screening system utilizing cross-checking procedures to verify eligibility for real property tax exemptions, credits, and dedications. Establishes a reporting requirement. Applies to tax years beginning July 1, 2028, and thereafter.

Status: INTRO → CCL

Latest action: Passed first reading.
